market.question: Will the highest temperature in Panama City be 32°C on April 29?

assessment.reasoning: AccuWeather forecast for Panama City, Panama on Apr 29 is high ~87°F = 30.6°C. April daytime high range is 87-94°F (~30.5-34.4°C). The 32°C bucket (31.5-32.5°C) is plausible but the central forecast points to 30-31°C. Market 0.37 may overweight 32°C.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Tropical microclimate variability; Marcos A. Gelabert station calibration vs forecast city averages.
